fusions.name: Butting Burl
fusions.desc: A knotted, wood-hard blow that deals 14 damage, knocks the target back 3 tiles, leaves it 12% easier to wound for 5 seconds and makes it [Bleeding] from splinters for 2 damage a second for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Taproot Stamp
fusions.desc: Stamps down through your roots, dealing 4 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles and leaving each 5% easier to wound for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Stand Fast
fusions.desc: Sinks roots into the ground beneath you, reducing the damage you take by 25% for 10 seconds. You restore 10 health.

fusions.name: Saxifrage Hold
fusions.desc: Your armour rises by 10%, and you regenerate 0.5 health a second, permanently.
